SYNTHETIC – NOT A REAL PATIENT
Low back pain began on 06/16/2026.
The patient denies trauma, fever, weight loss, bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, or progressive neurologic deficits.
There is diminished ankle reflex on the right side.
Patient is a 50-year-old female with aching lumbar pain worsened by flexion and prolonged sitting. Exam reveals lumbar paraspinal tenderness. Assessment: Lumbar radiculopathy likely L5/S1. Plan: Start ibuprofen 600 mg PO TID today; initiate a course of physical therapy to begin in a few days; advise activity modification and return in 2 weeks.
